name: SP3 Precise Orbit Source
description: Read precise orbit products in SP3-c and SP3-d (IGS and its analysis centres, BKG, ESA/ESOC: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou and low-Earth-orbit POD) into one canonical SDS OEM per satellite, in the frame and time system the header states, position-only states staying position-only. Download and decompression belong to the SDN host flow.

methods.displayName: Read an SP3 precise orbit file as OEM

acceptedTypeSets.description: One decompressed SP3-c or SP3-d precise orbit file (IGS, its analysis centres, BKG, ESA/ESOC) as text, bounded to 128 MiB; the host expands the gzip the data centres serve.

wildcardJustification.detail: One decompressed SP3-c or SP3-d precise orbit file (IGS, its analysis centres, BKG, ESA/ESOC) as text, bounded to 128 MiB; the host expands the gzip the data centres serve.

inputPorts.description: One decompressed SP3-c or SP3-d precise orbit file (IGS, its analysis centres, BKG, ESA/ESOC) as text, bounded to 128 MiB; the host expands the gzip the data centres serve.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One canonical $OEM per satellite with a position in the file, named for its SP3 vehicle id: Earth-fixed in the realization the header names (or the inertial frame it names), on the file's time system, position-only or with velocity as the file has it.

outputPorts.description: One canonical $OEM per satellite with a position in the file, named for its SP3 vehicle id: Earth-fixed in the realization the header names (or the inertial frame it names), on the file's time system, position-only or with velocity as the file has it.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The file's header facts (version, agency, coordinate system, orbit type, time system, epoch interval, first epoch), per satellite its states, blocks, velocity, accuracy exponent, clocks and flags, and the SHA-256 of the input; module control metadata the host keeps beside the file, not an observation.

wildcardJustification.detail: The file's header facts (version, agency, coordinate system, orbit type, time system, epoch interval, first epoch), per satellite its states, blocks, velocity, accuracy exponent, clocks and flags, and the SHA-256 of the input; module control metadata the host keeps beside the file, not an observation.

outputPorts.description: The file's header facts (version, agency, coordinate system, orbit type, time system, epoch interval, first epoch), per satellite its states, blocks, velocity, accuracy exponent, clocks and flags, and the SHA-256 of the input; module control metadata the host keeps beside the file, not an observation.

sequentialJustification.detail: One complete bounded orbit file is read in order into one record per satellite and one control frame; the host parallelizes independent files and this parser creates no threads.
